items.title: Gilead Sciences (GILD) Expands ADC Research With AI Tissue Analytics
items.summary: Gilead Sciences (NasdaqGS:GILD) announced a partnership with Nucleai to use AI-powered tissue analytics in its global antibody drug conjugate programs. The collaboration focuses on translational research to speed up biomarker discovery and support precision oncology development. The AI tools are intended to help standardize and accelerate analysis of tumor samples across Gilead’s oncology pipeline.
